etymology.historical_story: Dominic comes from Latin dominicus, meaning belonging to the Lord. The name was originally associated with children born on Sunday, the Lord’s day. It later spread through devotion to Saint Dominic, founder of the Dominican Order. This history explains the name’s Christian associations, but a modern bearer’s name alone does not establish their religion. [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/name/Dominic)
